description: This file contains utility functions and a class for managing Prisma database migrations, including environment setup, migration creation, resolution, rollback, and setup automation.

classes.name: ProxyExtrasDBManager
classes.description: A class providing static methods to manage Prisma database migrations, including creating baseline migrations, resolving, rolling back, and setting up the database.

methods.name: _get_prisma_dir
methods.description: Determines the Prisma migrations directory, supporting custom override via environment variable.

methods.name: _create_baseline_migration
methods.description: Creates a baseline migration for an existing database by generating and marking a migration as applied.

methods.name: _get_migration_names
methods.description: Retrieves all migration directory names from the migrations folder.

methods.name: _roll_back_migration
methods.description: Marks a specific migration as rolled back.

methods.name: _resolve_specific_migration
methods.description: Marks a specific migration as applied.

methods.name: _is_permission_error
methods.description: Checks if an error message indicates a database permission error.

methods.name: _is_idempotent_error
methods.description: Checks if an error message indicates an idempotent operation error.

methods.name: _resolve_all_migrations
methods.description: Generates and applies migration diffs, then marks all migrations as applied.

methods.name: setup_database
methods.description: Sets up the database using Prisma migrate or db push, with retries and error handling.
